name: Celsius Holdings
description: Celsius sells energy drinks (CELSIUS, Alani Nu, Rockstar) made by contract bottlers and sold mostly through PepsiCo, its largest customer (43.2% of FY2025 revenue) and primary US distributor, which also owns preferred shares and has board seats. Revenue doubled in 2025 (up 85.5% to $2,515M) mainly from acquiring Alani Nu ($1,002M in nine months) and Rockstar ($56M), while the CELSIUS brand grew only 7.5%. In Q2 2026 the CELSIUS brand fell 11.7% (trade spend, inventory rebalancing, club softness, fewer new products), and gross margin fell to 48.1% from 51.5%. It reached about a 20% dollar share of US energy drinks (20.1% in the 13 weeks to June 28, 2026: CELSIUS 9.5%, Rockstar 1.9%, Alani Nu about 8.7% derived).

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source in this pass.

hq.note: 2381 NW Executive Center Drive, Boca Raton, FL 33431 (FY2025 10-K read); incorporated in Nevada April 26, 2005

businessLines.name: CELSIUS
businessLines.how: Sells CELSIUS cans mostly to retailers and club stores through PepsiCo's distribution system in the US; earns product margin on volume; brand revenue fell 11.7% in Q2 2026.

businessLines.name: Alani Nu
businessLines.how: Acquired April 1, 2025 for $1,275.0M cash plus shares; energy drinks aimed at women, sold through the same system; FY2025 figure covers Q2 to Q4 only and includes Pepsi's initial inventory purchases.

businessLines.name: Rockstar Energy
businessLines.how: Acquired August 28, 2025; US rights to a legacy energy brand distributed by PepsiCo; FY2025 covers about four months.

whatsNext.text: Rockstar integration into the PepsiCo system finished by Q2 2026 per plan; management said gross margin percentage should be in the low 50s in 2026

profileAgainst: FY2025 10-K (period ended 2025-12-31) and Q4 2025 release; Q2 2026 release (2026-08-06)
